written.myAnswer: As the body falls, its potential energy decreases and is converted into kinetic energy. Neglecting air resistance, the total mechanical energy remains constant at mgh.
The ball’s kinetic energy is transferred to the window and is used to break the glass; some energy is also transferred as sound and heat.
Using v² = u² − 2gh at maximum height, h = u²/(2g) = 35²/(2 × 10) = 61.25 m.
Her maximum speed is 4 m s⁻¹, at the lowest point of the swing.
